name: Spiderman Hospital
look: A still from the 1960s Spider-Man cartoon showing Spider-Man in full costume lying in a hospital bed under white sheets, one hand resting on his chest. A bedside table holds a glass with a straw and a small bottle against a blue wall.
use: One of the 1960s Spider-Man cartoon memes. Captions explain, often absurdly, why Spider-Man ended up in the hospital, or have him deliver a deadpan line while bedridden, usually about getting sick or hurt in a silly way.
